about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn more about the team behind RCKeyBoard
about.intro_text: RCKeyBoard is a premium Android keyboard app with smart predictions, custom themes, multilingual support, and privacy-first performance. Our mission is to provide the best typing experience on Android devices, prioritizing user privacy and extensive customization.
about.mission_desc: To deliver the most responsive and customizable typing experience on Android.
about.vision_desc: A world where every user owns their digital expressions securely.
about.values_desc: Privacy, speed, inclusivity, and continuous innovation.
about.team_desc: Passionate developers dedicated to improving mobile communication.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your data, your control
privacy.intro_text: Your privacy is important to us. RCKeyBoard does not collect, store, or transmit your personal data without your explicit consent. All learning and prediction processes are performed locally on your device to ensure maximum security. We do not sell data to third parties.
privacy.collection_desc: RCKeyBoard does not collect personal typing data. All predictions and learning happen locally on your device.
privacy.storage_desc: No keystroke data is stored on external servers. Your typing patterns remain private.
privacy.third_party_desc: We do not share any user data with third parties. Your privacy is our priority.
privacy.rights_desc: You can clear all local learning data at any time through the app settings.
